meta.title: Glemo — Credentials that prove themselves
meta.description: The neutral verification network. Issue tamper-proof credentials and verify any credential, from any issuer, in one API call. No crypto knowledge required.

hero.sub: Glemo is the neutral verification network: issue tamper-proof credentials in minutes, and verify any credential — from any issuer — in one API call. No crypto knowledge required, on either side.
hero.microTrust: Built on open standards · W3C Verifiable Credentials · Open Badges 3.0 · GDPR-ready

problem.titleB: No one should have to trust one.
problem.body: AI made forging diplomas, certificates and CVs trivial. Verifying them still means emails, phone calls and days of waiting — so most credentials are never checked at all.

how.title: From issued to verified in milliseconds

steps.name: Issue
steps.body: Design and issue tamper-proof credentials — one at a time, or thousands from a spreadsheet. Recipients get theirs by email: no wallet, no app, no jargon.

steps.name: Hold
steps.body: Every credential is built on open standards, portable anywhere, and belongs to its holder. It keeps working — even without Glemo.

steps.name: Verify
steps.body: Any platform, employer or system checks authenticity in a single call — without ever contacting the issuer.

features.title: Everything issuers need. Nothing recipients have to learn.

scenes.title: A design studio for credentials
scenes.body: A visual editor with your branding, dynamic fields and bulk issuance from a spreadsheet. Certificates and badges that look like you — not like a template.

scenes.title: Delivery without friction
scenes.body: Recipients receive a link by email and a public verification page. Sharing to LinkedIn takes one click. Zero crypto steps, for anyone, ever.

scenes.title: Revocation and audit, built in
scenes.body: Revoke or expire any credential at any time. Every verification is logged, so your audit trail writes itself.

dev.title: Ship verification in an afternoon
dev.body: A clean REST API and SDKs. Verify any credential — including ones you didn't issue — with a single call, and get a signed answer you can trust.

items.q: Do I need to know anything about blockchain?
items.a: No. Neither do your recipients or your verifiers. Glemo uses cryptographic infrastructure under the hood, but every surface you touch is email, links and a REST API.

items.q: What happens to credentials if Glemo disappears?
items.a: They keep working. Credentials are built on open standards (W3C Verifiable Credentials, Open Badges 3.0) and are exportable and verifiable independently of us. No lock-in is a design requirement, not a promise.

items.q: Can I verify a credential that wasn't issued on Glemo?
items.a: That's the point of the network. Glemo verifies standards-based credentials from any compliant issuer — and our roadmap extends verification to sources that never adopted standards at all.
Off any public infrastructure. Personal data stays in conventional, GDPR-compliant storage; only cryptographic proofs are anchored publicly. Deleting a person's data remains possible — by design.
Issuing is designed to be accessible for institutions of any size; verification is billed per check for platforms at volume. We're onboarding design partners now — early terms are generous.
